cases.name: run-produces-verified-report
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d); .venv/bin/python scripts/gen_input.py "$w/input" --records 200 && .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output" && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('$w/output/report.json')); print('VERIFIED' if r['verification_passed'] else 'FAILED')"

cases.name: no-sensitive-value-leak
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d); .venv/bin/python scripts/gen_input.py "$w/input" --records 50 && .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output" && if grep -rq sk_synthetic_7CWQ0JY5i2 "$w/output/corpus"; then echo LEAK_DETECTED; exit 1; else echo NO_LEAK; fi

cases.name: fails-closed-on-unsupported-input
command: cd .. && set -euo pipefail; w=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$w/input/corpus"; cp examples/policy.json "$w/input/policy.json"; printf x >"$w/input/corpus/bad.parquet"; if .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output" >"$w/stdout" 2>"$w/stderr"; then exit 1; else rc=$?; fi; test "$rc" -ne 0; grep -F 'unsupported_format BATTLE_CONTRACT_REJECT' "$w/stderr"; test ! -e "$w/output/report.json"; test ! -e "$w/output/corpus"; echo FAILCLOSED_OK

cases.name: gate-pinned-evaluator-passes
command: cd .. && ./security/invariant_campaign_gate.sh anonymization-trial 20 && python3 -c "import json; a=json.load(open('security/battle/runs/acceptance-floor-latest/production-adapter-receipt.json')); b=json.load(open('security/battle/runs/latest/receipt.json')); assert a['status']=='PASS' and b['verdict']=='PASS'; print('BATTLE_READBACK_OK')"
